verificationSummary: Editor commit 747a7269838d457b940251be33cd275d80f9c3b4 adds an active text-block island commit runner in src/editor/draft/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.ts, a focused unit test in src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts, and live Backend harness coverage in src/tests/liveCompatibilityHarness.test.ts. The runner resolves the current active Editor draft through the text-block authoring boundary and active-island commit resolver, exposes the pending Editor runtime state before the Backend request resolves, sends the request through FlowDocBackendClient.commitMutation, reads the latest Editor runtime state before applying the response, and applies the Backend mutation result through applyRuntimeBackendMutationResult so the existing stale gate and active-island lifecycle remain authoritative. The accepted RED was npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts failing because ../editor/draft/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner did not exist. GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts with 1 file and 3 tests. Live proof passed npx vitest run src/tests/liveCompatibilityHarness.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts with 2 files and 4 tests after the loopback Backend path read the seeded document, migrated it, applied reorder and rich-inline mutations, then committed a dirty active text-block island draft through the runner and applied the returned Backend mutation envelope into Editor runtime. Focused regression passed npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts src/tests/liveCompatibilityHarness.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandLifecycle.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/v4ReadOnly.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts with 7 files and 23 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, 94 test files with 326 tests, and build. This evidence does not enable visible text input, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip input, rich-inline flattening, React canvas input binding, collaboration, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; it was not remediated in this lane. The linked Editor worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 remains intentionally retained on branch editor-active-text-island-commit-runner-20260830 because its node_modules contains junctions to Core and previous recursive cleanup exposed dependency-link side effects that deleted Core tracked files under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm. Project Control registration used a dedicated worktree; its initial npm run check hit Vitest fork worker start timeouts before record edits, while npm test -- --maxWorkers=1, npm run build, and npm run test:e2e passed.
